hook_reads_in_one_second.instructions: A muted viewer scrolling past understands the `marketing_idea.hook` (two flags and 'vs') as a competition within the first second of the video.

comments_drive_the_loop.instructions: Asking viewers to 'comment the next matchup' in `marketing_idea.concept` produces enough comments per video to keep choosing the next matchup from them.

ad_matches_app_today.instructions: The country-vs-country video in `marketing_idea` accurately represents what a player can do in the app as described in `product_gap`.

criteria.true: A player who installs from the ad can play a flag-vs-flag match and see a winner named, as the ad shows.
criteria.false: The ad shows flags or a named winner that the app does not offer.

versus_before_paid.instructions: Versus mode with flag skins and a winner card should ship in the app before any paid ad from `marketing_idea` runs.

two_player_one_phone_is_the_hook.instructions: Letting two people share one phone, one lane each, makes the country-vs-country framing stronger than one person playing both flags.

policy_risk.instructions: How likely ads built on `marketing_idea`, following `marketing_idea.matchup_rule`, are to be rejected by Meta or TikTok ad review.
criteria: Approved like any ordinary game ad
Occasional rejections on specific matchups, fixed by swapping the pair
Frequent rejections that force a change of concept

best_first_channel.instructions: Which channel the founder in `constraints` should start `marketing_idea` on.

criteria.tiktok_organic: Free posts on a TikTok account
criteria.all_three_organic: The same clip posted to all three free channels
criteria.paid_meta: Paid ads on Facebook and Instagram from day one
criteria.paid_tiktok: Paid ads on TikTok from day one

best_ad_length.instructions: Which video length gives `marketing_idea` the best install rate for a first paid test.

criteria.six_to_eight: 6-8 seconds: one short run and the crash
criteria.eight_to_fifteen: 8-15 seconds: a run with a boost or near miss, then the crash
criteria.fifteen_to_thirty: 15-30 seconds: a longer match with several moments

first_soft_launch_market.instructions: Which market to soft-launch in first, given `game.monetization_plan` and `constraints`.

criteria.canada: Canada: behaves like the US, higher install costs
criteria.australia: Australia: standard soft-launch market, behaves like the US
criteria.philippines: Philippines: cheap installs, common for ad-funded games

creative_style.instructions: Which video style best suits `marketing_idea` for this solo founder.

criteria.gameplay_with_voice: Screen recording with the founder's voice calling the match
criteria.creator_reaction: The founder or a creator on camera reacting to the match

fit_with_game.instructions: How well `marketing_idea` shows off what is actually fun about the game in `game.core_loop`.
criteria: Hides the core loop; the flags carry the whole video
Shows the loop, but the flags are doing most of the work
The loop and the flags reinforce each other: threading and crashing are the drama

d1_bar_reachable.instructions: Players acquired through `marketing_idea` reach the day-1 retention target in `targets.d1_retention`.
